docs.title: TMT / iTRAQ Multiplexed Quantitative Proteomics
docs.text: Category: Proteomics Tier: 2 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Isobaric tagging — 동일 mass / 다른 reporter ion 으로 6-18 samples 한 번에 quantitative MS. Channel 간 quant 정확도 ↑, missing value 적음 (vs LFQ), 대규모 cohort에 효율적.

누가 의뢰: 임상 cohort proteomics (CPTAC), drug perturbation panel, kinetic time-course, multi-condition comparison.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Reagent: TMT 10/11/16/18-plex (Thermo), iTRAQ 4/8-plex (Sciex)
  • Sample: 100 µg / channel (TMT16: 1.6 mg total)
  • Bridge sample 필수 — multi-set normalization
  • MS: MS3 권장 (SPS-MS3, Orbitrap Eclipse/Exploris) — interference 감소

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text:
Lysis → tryptic digest → TMT labeling → pool 16 channels
  → fractionation (HpRP) → LC-MS3
  → MaxQuant / FragPipe (TMT search)
  → IsobarQuant / DEqMS / MSstatsTMT (stats)
  → batch correction across TMT sets
  → DE + pathway → Report
Tool Version Purpose MaxQuant (TMT mode) 2.6 – FragPipe TMT-Integrator 21.1 open-source TMT MSstatsTMT R 2.14 stats with normalization DEqMS R 1.24 variance shrinkage IsobarQuant – EMBL pipeline

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Protein × sample log-ratio, DE results, bridge-normalized cross-set, batch QC

docs.title: Demo / Time
docs.text:
• CPTAC TMT11 lung cancer dataset
  • ~24 h per TMT16 set

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Ratio compression (co-isolation) — MS3 mitigates but not eliminates
  • ⚠ Bridge sample → cross-set comparison 정확도 의존
  • ⚠ Reagent batch 차이 — same lot 권장
  • ⚠ Limited dynamic range vs LFQ for very low abundance
  • ⚠ Cost — reagent 비용 sample당 $$$

docs.title: References
docs.text:
• Thompson A, et al. Tandem mass tags: a novel quantification strategy for comparative analysis of complex protein mixtures by MS/MS. Anal Chem 2003.
  • McAlister GC, et al. MultiNotch MS3 enables accurate, sensitive, and multiplexed detection of differential expression across cancer cell line proteomes. Anal Chem 2014.

docs.title: Affinity Pull-down MS (AP-MS / IP-MS / TurboID)
docs.text: Category: Proteomics Tier: 2 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
특정 단백질 (bait) 의 상호작용자 (prey) 를 immunoprecipitation 또는 proximity labeling (BioID/TurboID/APEX2) 으로 enrich → MS로 동정. PPI 발견의 gold standard.

누가 의뢰: drug target interactome, transcription complex 구성, signaling pathway 구성원, viral host factor 발굴.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Bait: tagged protein (FLAG, HA, GFP) over-expressed + IgG/parental control
  • Or proximity labeling: BioID/TurboID/APEX2 + biotin substrate
  • Replicate: ≥3 bait + ≥3 control
  • MS: standard DDA or DIA

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text:
Lysate → IP (tag-specific antibody) or streptavidin (biotinylated)
  → on-bead digest → LC-MS/MS (DDA or DIA)
  → MaxQuant LFQ
  → SAINT / SAINTexpress / MiST — interaction probability scoring
  → CompPASS — control-aware filter
  → Cytoscape network visualization
  → ProHits-viz / dot plot → Report
Tool Version Purpose SAINTexpress 3.6 Bayesian interaction probability MiST – mass spec interaction statistics CompPASS – comparative AP-MS scoring Cytoscape 3.10 network viz ProHits-viz – dot plot generation STRING / BioGRID – reference PPI DB

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Bait × prey interaction table + SAINT BFDR, network plot, dot plot, known vs novel interactor

docs.title: Demo / Time
docs.text:
• BioPlex 3.0 public AP-MS data
  • ~4 h per bait (with multiple control)

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Indirect interactors capture — co-complex vs direct binding 불분명
  • ❌ Tag overexpression artifact — endogenous tagging (CRISPR knock-in) 권장
  • ⚠ Lysis condition (gentle vs strong) — interactome 크게 변함
  • ⚠ Control 의 중요성 — proper isotype/parental/untagged 필수
  • ⚠ Transient interaction missed (crosslinking 보완)

docs.title: References
docs.text:
• Teo G, et al. SAINTexpress: improvements and additional features in Significance Analysis of INTeractome software. J Proteomics 2014.
  • Roux KJ, et al. A promiscuous biotin ligase fusion protein identifies proximal and interacting proteins in mammalian cells (BioID). J Cell Biol 2012.

docs.title: Olink / SomaScan / Antibody Arrays (Targeted Proteome)
docs.text: Category: Proteomics Tier: 2 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Olink PEA (Proximity Extension Assay) / SomaScan (aptamer) / Luminex — 항체/aptamer 기반 targeted proteome. MS와 달리 plasma/serum 등 low-abundance 단백질을 sensitivity 높게 측정. 임상 biomarker cohort에 표준.

누가 의뢰: 대규모 plasma cohort (UK Biobank Olink Explore, 3072 panel; SomaScan 7K), longitudinal biomarker, multi-disease screening.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Plasma / serum / CSF: 1-50 µL
  • Sample size: 100-100,000 (대규모 cohort 효율 우수)
  • Format: NPX (Olink) 또는 RFU (SomaScan) values
  • Replicate: bridge sample 필수

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text:
NPX/RFU matrix → QC (Limits of Detection, IQR)
  → batch correction (Olink Bridge, ComBat)
  → normalization
  → DE (linear models, limma)
  → ProteomicsDB / UniProt annotation
  → Mendelian randomization / pQTL (genome-paired)
  → Disease prediction (Cox PH, ML)
  → Pathway enrichment (GO, KEGG, STRING)
  → Report
Tool / Resource Version Purpose Olink Analyse R 3.7 official analysis package OlinkR / Olink Insights – – somascan.tools R SomaScan analysis OpenStudy / ProteomicsDB – reference proteAaq – Olink/SomaScan QC

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Protein × sample (NPX/RFU), DE results, predictive models (AUC), pQTL associations, pathway enrichments

docs.title: Demo / Time
docs.text:
• UK Biobank Olink Explore 3072 (~50k participants, publicly summarized)
  • Per-cohort analysis: ~2-4 h

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Antibody/aptamer specificity — cross-reactivity 가능. orthogonal MS 검증 권장
  • ❌ Panel-limited — pre-selected targets만 측정
  • ⚠ Olink/SomaScan 결과 직접 비교 어려움 (다른 platform)
  • ⚠ Batch effect 큼 — bridge sample 필수
  • ⚠ pQTL 분석 시 antibody epitope masking effect 고려

docs.title: References
docs.text:
• Assarsson E, et al. Homogeneous 96-plex PEA immunoassay exhibiting high sensitivity, specificity, and excellent scalability (Olink PEA). PLoS One 2014.
  • Gold L, et al. Aptamer-based multiplexed proteomic technology for biomarker discovery (SomaScan). PLoS One 2010.
  • Sun BB, et al. Plasma proteomic associations with genetics and health in the UK Biobank. Nature 2023.

docs.title: Targeted LC-MS / MRM Metabolomics
docs.text: Category: Metabolomics Tier: 2 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
알려진 metabolite (panel of 50-500) 의 Multiple Reaction Monitoring (MRM) 또는 PRM — high sensitivity, 절대 정량 (isotope-labeled internal standards). 임상 routine, 약물 PK 표준.

누가 의뢰: drug PK/PD, 임상 진단 panel (acylcarnitine, amino acid for inborn errors of metabolism), 영양 (vitamin/lipid panel), 위치-특이 metabolic flux.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Sample: serum/plasma/tissue/cell
  • Internal standards: isotope-labeled (¹³C, ²H, ¹⁵N) per target
  • MS: triple-quadrupole (QqQ) — Sciex 6500, Waters TQ-XS
  • Sample size: 20-1000 (clinical cohort)

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text:
Sample → extract → derivatize (if needed, e.g., AccQ-Tag amino acid)
  → LC + QqQ MRM → Skyline (peak integration)
  → calibration curve → absolute quantification
  → MetaboAnalyst (univariate + multivariate)
  → clinical correlation → Report
Tool Version Purpose Skyline 23 targeted MS gold standard MultiQuant – Sciex commercial MetaboAnalyst 6.0 downstream stats TargetLynx – Waters commercial

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Concentration matrix (µM), QC pass/fail, pathway/clinical interpretation

docs.title: Demo / Time
docs.text:
• Biocrates MxP Quant 500 standardized panel
  • ~10 min / sample MRM acquisition

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Pre-selected targets만 — discovery 한계 (untargeted 보완)
  • ⚠ Matrix effect — extraction efficiency 검증 필수
  • ⚠ Internal standard 가용성 — 모든 metabolite에 isotope-label 존재 X
  • ⚠ Dynamic range 한계 (1000-fold ~ 10000-fold)

docs.title: References
docs.text:

docs.title: ITS Fungal Amplicon Profiling
docs.text: Category: Microbiome Tier: 2 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Internal Transcribed Spacer (ITS1/ITS2) amplicon sequencing — fungal community 동정. 16S가 박테리아용이라면 ITS는 fungal 표준. 종/속 수준 fungal microbiome.

누가 의뢰: 식품/와인/김치 fermentation, 농업 식물병 (Fusarium, Aspergillus 등), 임상 진균증, 환경 fungal diversity.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Primer: ITS1F/ITS2 (ITS1 region) 또는 ITS3/ITS4 (ITS2)
  • Format: paired-end Illumina (V2 chemistry로 ITS 길이 가변성 대응)
  • Reads / sample: 10,000-50,000
  • Mock community: ZymoBIOMICS fungal mock 권장

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text:
FASTQ → ITSx (ITS region extraction — flanking SSU/LSU 제거)
  → DADA2 / VSEARCH (denoise to ASVs)
  → taxonomy vs UNITE database
  → diversity, ordination, differential abundance (QIIME 2)
  → Report

docs.text:

docs.title: Antibiotic Resistance Gene (ARG) Profiling
docs.text: Category: Microbiome Tier: 2 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Shotgun metagenomics 또는 isolate WGS 로부터 항생제 내성 유전자 검출. CARD/Resistome 기반 — 임상 (병원감염), 농축산 (가축 사료, 분뇨), 환경 (하수, 토양) 모두 적용.

누가 의뢰: 병원 내 다제내성균 surveillance, 식품 안전 (가축 분리주), one-health 모니터링.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Shotgun metagenome FASTQ (deeper for sensitivity)
  • 또는 isolate 게놈 (assembled or short-read)
  • Reference DB: CARD, ResFinder, NCBI AMRfinderPlus DB

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text:
[Metagenome]
FASTQ → host removal → CARD/RGI bwt mode (read-based)
  → ARG abundance per sample → relative quantification (RPKM)

[Isolate]
Assembly → CARD/RGI / AMRfinderPlus / ResFinder
  → presence/absence calls → MLST / clone tracking

→ contig context: plasmid (mob-suite) vs chromosomal
→ host bacteria assignment (host-tracking)
→ Report

• CHARM/EARN public hospital surveillance

docs.title: Virome (DNA / RNA Viruses)
docs.text: Category: Microbiome Tier: 2 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Metagenomics / metatranscriptomics 에서 viral sequence 검출 + 분류 + 신종 발견. Phage (gut virome), eukaryotic virus (감염병), 환경 virome.

누가 의뢰: 임상 진단 (sepsis pan-viral panel), gut phage-bacteria interaction, 식품/수산 viral outbreak, 환경 viral diversity.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Shotgun metagenome (DNA virus) 또는 metatranscriptome (RNA virus 포함)
  • Virion-enriched library (filtration + DNase + RNase) 권장 — eukaryotic virus
  • Read depth: 5-20 GB / sample
  • Negative control 필수 — kitome contamination

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text:
FASTQ → host removal → assembly (metaSPAdes / Flye)
  → viral contig prediction:
     ├─ VirSorter2 — multi-classifier
     ├─ geNomad — comprehensive, plasmid+virus
     ├─ viralVerify / CheckV (quality assessment)
  → taxonomy (vConTACT2, BLASTn vs RefSeq/IMG/VR)
  → host prediction (CRISPR spacer, iPHoP)
  → AMG (auxiliary metabolic genes) — DRAMv
  → abundance (read recruitment)
  → Report
Tool Version Purpose VirSorter2 2.2 classic viral detection geNomad 1.8 virus + plasmid + chromosomal CheckV 1.0 viral genome completeness vConTACT3 0.3 gene-sharing network taxonomy iPHoP 1.3 host prediction DRAMv 1.5 viral functional annotation viralFlye 0.2 long-read viral assembly

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Viral contigs (FASTA + quality), taxonomy, host prediction, abundance, AMG profile

docs.title: Demo / Time
docs.text:
• Gut virome dataset (Gregory et al. 2020)
  • ~24 h per sample

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Reference incompleteness — novel virus 비율 ↑, IMG/VR + RefSeq 결합 권장

docs.title: MOFA+ Multi-omics Factor Analysis
docs.text: Category: Multi-omics Tier: 2 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
여러 omics layer (RNA + ATAC + protein + metabolomics 등) 를 공통 latent factor 로 분해하는 unsupervised factor analysis. 각 factor의 sample/cell weighting 과 feature loading 을 통해 cross-omics 변동 축 발견.

누가 의뢰: cohort multi-omics (CPTAC 등), 임상 multi-modality, single-cell multi-omics (CITE/multiome) downstream.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• 각 modality의 matrix: gene × sample (RNA), peak × sample (ATAC), protein × sample
  • Sample 매칭 필수 (paired)
  • Cell-level (MEFISTO): spatial/temporal axis 포함

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text:
Multiple normalized matrices (paired samples)
  → MOFA+ training → K latent factors
  → factor variance per modality → assess shared vs unique
  → top features per factor (loadings)
  → factor × phenotype correlation → biological interpretation
  → enrichment per factor → Report
Tool Version Purpose MOFA+ R/Python 1.10 factor analysis MEFISTO – spatial/temporal MOFA muon 0.1 MuData multi-modal in Python mixOmics R 6.30 block PLS alternative

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Factor weights × sample, loadings per feature, variance decomposition, factor-phenotype correlations

docs.title: Demo / Time
docs.text:
• CLL data (Argelaguet et al. MOFA paper) — public
  • ~30 min for moderate cohort

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Linear model — non-linear relationships missed (deep learning 대안)
  • ⚠ Factor 해석은 사람 — 자동 X
  • ⚠ Modality 별 sample 결측 처리 정책 명시
  • ⚠ Single-cell scale은 muon/MEFISTO 권장

docs.text:

docs.title: Drug–Gene Interaction & Repurposing
docs.text: Category: Functional Tier: 2 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
유전자 변이/발현 signature 으로 drug-gene interaction DB 매칭 (DGIdb, OncoKB, DrugBank) — actionable target 추출 — 또는 transcriptomic signature reversal (CMap/LINCS L1000) 으로 drug repurposing 후보 도출.

docs.text:
[Drug-gene matching]
Gene list / variants → DGIdb / OncoKB / DrugBank API
  → actionable variant → drug list + evidence level

[Signature repurposing]

  → connectivity score → reverse-correlated drugs (anti-signature)
  → tissue/cell-line specificity filter
  → mechanism enrichment

  • ⚠ Drug 다중 target / off-target 정보 누락 가능

docs.title: Cancer Driver Gene Detection
docs.text: Category: Functional / Genomics Tier: 2 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
종양 cohort 의 somatic mutation 패턴에서 driver gene (positive selection 의 표적) 검출. Background mutation rate 보정 후 비유전적 enrichment 통계로 식별. precision oncology의 핵심.

누가 의뢰: 종양 cohort sequencing → driver landscape, 신규 cancer-driver discovery, 임상 actionable list 작성.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Somatic mutation calls: MAF / VCF (tumor-normal pair)
  • Cohort: ≥50 samples 권장 (검정력)
  • Tumor type: 동일 cancer type (cross-cancer는 별도)

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text:
Somatic MAF
  ├─ MutSigCV / MutSig2CV — background-aware mutation rate
  ├─ dNdScv — dN/dS (positive selection)
  ├─ OncodriveCLUSTL — mutation clustering in protein
  ├─ OncodriveFML — functional impact
  ├─ HotMAPS / 3D — structural hotspot
  ↓
Consensus drivers + functional annotation (OncoKB, COSMIC, Cancer Gene Census)
Oncoplot / driver landscape → cohort 해석 → Report
Tool Version Purpose MutSig2CV – gold standard dNdScv R 0.1 Sanger method OncodriveCLUSTL 1.1 clustering OncodriveFML 2.4 functional HotMAPS – 3D hotspot maftools R/Bioc 2.22 viz + downstream OncoKB / Cancer Gene Census – annotation

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Driver gene list with FDR, oncoplot, mutation hotspots (3D structure 가능), pathway-level driver summary

docs.title: Demo / Time
docs.text:
• TCGA-LUAD MAF
  • ~2-6 h per cohort

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Sample size 의존 — n<30은 검정력 부족
  • ⚠ Background rate 모델 의존 — TMB 차이 큰 cohort 보정 필요
  • ⚠ Non-coding driver는 별도 (NCDriver, OncodriveFML-nc)
  • ⚠ Driver ≠ therapeutic target — functional validation 필요

docs.title: References
docs.text:
• Lawrence MS, et al. Mutational heterogeneity in cancer and the search for new cancer-associated genes (MutSigCV). Nature 2013.
  • Martincorena I, et al. Universal Patterns of Selection in Cancer and Somatic Tissues (dNdScv). Cell 2017.
  • Sondka Z, et al. The COSMIC Cancer Gene Census: describing genetic dysfunction across all human cancers. Nat Rev Cancer 2018.

docs.title: Survival / Clinical Association Analysis
docs.text: Category: Functional / Clinical Tier: 2 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
유전자 발현 / 변이 / methylation / proteomics 신호와 임상 결과 (OS, PFS, DSS, response) 의 연관 분석. Kaplan-Meier, Cox PH, time-dependent ROC, ML-based prognostic models.

누가 의뢰: 임상 cohort biomarker validation, drug response prediction, prognostic signature 검증.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Expression / variant / clinical matrix: feature × sample
  • Clinical: OS time, OS event, age, sex, stage, treatment, response
  • Sample: ≥50 events 권장 (Cox 모델 검정력)
  • Validation cohort: independent split

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text:
Clinical + omics
  → univariate: log-rank (KM), Cox (HR, p)
  → multivariable Cox (adjusted for confounders)
  → high/low stratification (median, optimal cutoff via maxstat)
  → time-dependent ROC, C-index
  → ML prognostic: glmnet (Cox elastic net), randomForestSRC, DeepSurv
  → Calibration + decision curve analysis
  → Validation in independent cohort
  → Report
Tool Version Purpose survival / survminer R 3.7 / 0.5 KM, Cox, viz lifelines Python 0.30 – glmnet R 4.1 penalized Cox randomForestSRC R 3.3 RSF DeepSurv / PyCox 0.3 deep survival maxstat / cutpointr R optimal cutpoint rms R 6.8 Calibration pec R 2024 prediction error curves

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • KM curves, Cox HR forest plot, time-ROC, C-index, prognostic model + validation, nomogram

docs.title: Demo / Time
docs.text:
• TCGA TPM + clinical → Cox PH per gene
  • ~30 min – 2 h

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Censoring + competing risks — informative censoring 가정 검증
  • ❌ Optimal cutpoint over-fitting — independent validation 필수
  • ⚠ Cohort heterogeneity (stage, treatment) — stratification 필요
  • ⚠ Proportional hazards 가정 위반 시 time-dependent Cox 권장

docs.text:

docs.title: RNA Stability / Decay (SLAM-seq, BRIC-seq, 4sU-seq)
docs.text: Category: Transcriptomics Tier: 3 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
mRNA half-life 측정 — synthesis (production rate) vs decay (degradation rate) 를 metabolic labeling 으로 분리. Steady-state 변화의 원인 (전사? 안정성?) 해명.

누가 의뢰: m6A/codon optimality 효과, miRNA target half-life 감소, stress granule effect.

docs.text:
• 4-thiouridine (4sU) labeled RNA + alkylation chemistry (SLAM-seq)
  • Time-course sampling

docs.title: Pipeline / Tools
docs.text:
• slamdunk — SLAM-seq pipeline
  • GRAND-SLAM — Bayesian half-life
  • pulseR — kinetic modeling
  • BakR — Bayesian rate inference

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Per-gene synthesis rate, decay rate, half-life

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ 4sU toxicity at long incubation
  • ⚠ Conversion efficiency variable
  • ⚠ Computational kinetic model assumptions

docs.title: References
docs.text:

docs.title: Perturb-seq / CRISPR Screen scRNA-seq
docs.text: Category: Single-cell Tier: 3 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
CRISPR sgRNA perturbation + scRNA-seq — 수천 perturbation 의 transcriptomic effect 동시 측정. Gene function 발견, pathway 추론, drug target mechanism.

Heritable DNA barcode 를 단일 세포에 도입 → 자손 세포 family tree 추적. Static scRNA의 trajectory 추론 한계를 극복하고 실제 lineage 확인.

  • CoSpar — clonal + dynamic
  • CellTagging — combinatorial barcode
  • GASTRULA / scGESTALT — CRISPR scarring barcode

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Single-cell bisulfite sequencing — 세포 type별 methylome heterogeneity. Bulk WGBS의 평균 신호 한계를 단일세포 해상도로 해부.

docs.title: HiChIP / ChIA-PET (Protein-specific 3D Genome)

docs.text:
Hi-C + specific protein IP — TF (CTCF, YY1) 또는 histone mark (H3K27ac) 매개 chromatin loop 만 선택적 enrich. 전체 Hi-C보다 enhancer-promoter loop 검출에 더 효율적.

docs.title: DamID / TaDa (Tissue-specific Chromatin)
docs.text: Category: Epigenomics Tier: 3 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Dam (DNA adenine methyltransferase) 와 fusion된 단백질이 결합하는 chromatin 영역에 GATC adenine methylation 표시 → DpnI digest 로 분리. No antibody, no crosslinking, low cell number 가능.

누가 의뢰: 항체 없는 단백질 (rare TF, complex), in vivo Drosophila tissue, low-input lineage chromatin.

• damidseq_pipeline — Marshall lab
  • DamMapper
  • Custom enrichment normalization vs Dam-only control

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Bound chromatin tracks, DamID peak calls, gene-level binding

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Resolution limited by GATC site distribution
  • ⚠ Background correction critical
  • ⚠ Mostly used in Drosophila / model organisms

docs.text:

docs.title: ATAC-seq Footprinting (TF Binding Inference)
docs.text: Category: Epigenomics Tier: 3 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
ATAC-seq cut profile 의 단백질 결합 "footprint" (protected region) 패턴에서 TF binding 직접 추론 — ChIP-seq 없이 TF activity 변화 측정.

누가 의뢰: ChIP-seq 불가능 sample (low input, FFPE) 의 TF inference, drug treatment TF activity 변화.

docs.title: Pipeline / Tools
docs.text:
• TOBIAS — gold standard (BINDetect, ATACorrect)
  • HINT-ATAC
  • chromVAR — motif accessibility variability (bulk + single-cell)

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • TF footprint scores, differential TF binding, TF activity per condition

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Tn5 bias correction critical
  • ⚠ Resolution lower than ChIP-seq
  • ⚠ Family-shared motifs ambiguous

docs.title: Cross-linking Mass Spectrometry (XL-MS)
docs.text: Category: Proteomics Tier: 3 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Chemical cross-linker (DSSO, BS3, PhoX 등) 로 protein interactome 의 direct contact 를 covalently fix 후 MS로 cross-linked peptide identify → 구조 + interaction 동시 정보.

  • MeroX
  • xQuest / xProphet
  • MS Annika — Proteome Discoverer

docs.text: • Cross-linked peptide pairs with residue-level info, distance constraints, network

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:

  • ❌ Sub-stoichiometric crosslinks → low signal
  • ⚠ Sample prep complex

docs.title: NMR Metabolomics
docs.text: Category: Metabolomics Tier: 3 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
¹H-NMR 으로 metabolite quantification — 비파괴, sample 회수, high reproducibility, absolute quantification. MS와 보완 관계 (NMR은 더 정량적, MS는 더 sensitive).

누가 의뢰: 식품 fingerprinting, body fluid (urine, plasma), 보전 시료 (NMR은 비파괴).

docs.text:
• Sample in NMR tube (D₂O buffer, TSP-d4 internal standard)

docs.text:
• Chenomx NMR Suite — commercial gold standard
  • rNMR / nmrML
  • MetaboAnalyst — downstream stats

docs.text:
• ❌ Sensitivity lower than MS (mM vs µM-nM)
  • ❌ Limited coverage (~100 metabolites typical)
  • ⚠ Overlap of peaks in complex mixture

docs.title: Stable Isotope Tracing (¹³C MFA)
docs.text: Category: Metabolomics Tier: 3 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
¹³C / ²H / ¹⁵N-labeled substrate (e.g., [U-¹³C]-glucose, glutamine) 를 세포/조직에 공급 → metabolite의 isotope incorporation pattern 측정 → metabolic flux (TCA, glycolysis, anaplerosis) 정량.

docs.title: Pipeline / Tools
docs.text:

  • mfapy — Python MFA
  • OpenFLUX2
  • MAVEN / X¹³CMS — LC-MS isotope analysis

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Isotopologue distribution, calculated fluxes (mmol/g DCW/h), pathway activity map

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Steady-state assumption (or modeling time-resolved)
  • ❌ Compartmentalization (cytosol vs mitochondria) ambiguous
  • ⚠ Cost of labeled substrate

Shotgun metagenomics 에서 species 내 strain 다양성 분석 — 동일 종 내 SNV/structural variant 패턴, vertical transmission (mother→infant), strain replacement / persistence.

미생물 community RNA-seq — 누가 살고 있는가 (16S/shotgun DNA) → 무엇을 발현하는가 (RNA). 환경/host stress 반응, 기능 활성도 측정.

docs.title: ESMFold / OmegaFold (Single-sequence Structure)
docs.text: Category: Structural Tier: 3 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Single-sequence based structure prediction — MSA 없이 protein language model (ESM-2) 으로 빠른 예측. AlphaFold 2/3 보다 약간 낮은 정확도이나 수십배 빠름 — high-throughput, MSA-poor sequences.

누가 의뢰: 대규모 proteome structure prediction, AlphaFold MSA 부족 sequences (rare/divergent), 빠른 prototype.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Single FASTA (single sequence)
  • No MSA, no template required

docs.title: Pipeline / Tools
docs.text:
• ESMFold (ESM-2) — Meta AI
  • OmegaFold — Helixon
  • HelixFold-Single

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • PDB structure + pLDDT confidence

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Accuracy slightly lower than AlphaFold (especially for very rare folds)
  • ⚠ Quality drops for designed/de novo proteins
  • ⚠ No multimer support (use AF-Multimer)

docs.title: References
docs.text:
• Lin Z, et al. Evolutionary-scale prediction of atomic-level protein structure with a language model (ESMFold). Science 2023.

docs.title: Protein–Protein Docking
docs.text: Category: Structural Tier: 3 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
두 단백질 구조를 결합한 complex 의 docking pose 예측 — antibody-antigen, signaling complex, drug-protein. AlphaFold-Multimer가 새로운 기준이나 specialized docking이 여전히 유용.

누가 의뢰: 항체-항원 docking (CDR engineering), 단백질 design 검증, signaling complex hypothesis.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Two protein structures (or sequences if AF-Multimer)
  • Optional: binding interface hint (mutagenesis, HDX-MS)

docs.title: Pipeline / Tools
docs.text:
• HADDOCK 3 — flexible docking + experimental data integration
  • ClusPro — global rigid + clustering
  • AlphaFold-Multimer — DL-based
  • ZDOCK / pyDOCK
  • PIPER

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Top complex poses (PDB), interface residues, ranking scores

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Flexibility limited (rigid/semi-flexible)
  • ⚠ Scoring functions inaccurate for membrane proteins
  • ⚠ Experimental restraints often needed for accurate

docs.title: References
docs.text:
• van Zundert GCP, et al. The HADDOCK2.4 Web Server: a Suite for Integrative Modeling. J Mol Biol 2024.

docs.title: Protein–Ligand Docking (Small Molecule)
docs.text: Category: Structural Tier: 3 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Small molecule (drug, metabolite, inhibitor) 의 단백질 binding pose 와 affinity 예측 — drug discovery, target-fragment optimization, repurposing.

누가 의뢰: drug screening / virtual screening, lead optimization, metabolite-enzyme interaction.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Receptor structure (X-ray, cryo-EM, AlphaFold)
  • Ligand library (SMILES, SDF)
  • Binding site definition (or blind docking)

docs.title: Pipeline / Tools
docs.text:
• AutoDock Vina / Vina-GPU — classical
  • DiffDock — DL-based
  • Glide (Schrödinger commercial)
  • GNINA — DL scoring
  • rDock / Smina
  • MOE / OpenEye

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Top binding poses (PDB), predicted affinity (kcal/mol), interaction map

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Scoring vs binding affinity correlation moderate
  • ❌ Protein flexibility limited
  • ⚠ Solvent/entropy effects underestimated
  • ⚠ Experimental validation (IC50, ITC) needed

docs.title: References
docs.text:
• Eberhardt J, et al. AutoDock Vina 1.2.0. J Chem Inf Model 2021.
  • Corso G, et al. DiffDock: Diffusion Steps, Twists, and Turns for Molecular Docking. ICLR 2023.

docs.title: Molecular Dynamics (MD) Simulation
docs.text: Category: Structural Tier: 3 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
단백질/막/리간드의 time-resolved atomic motion 을 simulate — flexibility, binding kinetics, conformational change, allostery. ns–µs timescale, GPU 가속으로 routine.

누가 의뢰: drug binding kinetics, allosteric mechanism, membrane protein dynamics, mutation effect on stability.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Starting structure (PDB)
  • Force field (AMBER, CHARMM, GROMOS)
  • Solvent + ion setup

docs.title: Pipeline / Tools
docs.text:
• GROMACS — popular, GPU-accelerated
  • OpenMM — Python-friendly
  • AMBER — commercial
  • NAMD — VMD ecosystem
  • MDAnalysis / MDTraj — trajectory analysis

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Trajectory (XTC/DCD), RMSD/RMSF, hydrogen bond, free energy landscape (FEL)

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Timescale limited (typically ns–µs, vs biological ms–s)
  • ❌ Force field accuracy for unusual residues/lipids
  • ⚠ Sampling sufficiency for rare events (enhanced sampling — REMD, metadynamics)
  • ⚠ Computational cost (GPU days for large systems)

docs.title: References
docs.text:
• Abraham MJ, et al. GROMACS: High performance molecular simulations through multi-level parallelism. SoftwareX 2015.

docs.title: Cryo-EM Single Particle Analysis
docs.text: Category: Structural Tier: 3 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Cryo-EM 으로 macromolecular complex 의 high-resolution structure (3-4 Å typical, 1-2 Å with new detectors) 결정. X-ray crystallography 대안 — crystallization 불가능 sample 가능.

누가 의뢰: 거대 complex (ribosome, RNA polymerase II, viral capsid), membrane protein, dynamic complex.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Cryo-EM micrographs (Krios / Glacios)
  • 1000-10000 micrographs / dataset
  • 10⁵-10⁶ particle picks

docs.title: Pipeline / Tools
docs.text:
• RELION 5 — open-source gold standard
  • cryoSPARC — commercial, GPU-fast
  • CTFFIND / Gctf — CTF estimation
  • Topaz / crYOLO — DL particle picking
  • Phenix — refinement (atomic model)
  • ChimeraX — visualization

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • 3D density map (MRC), atomic model (PDB), FSC resolution curve

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ Sample prep (vitrification, ice quality) decisive
  • ❌ Computational cost (GPU days for large datasets)
  • ⚠ Preferred orientation bias
  • ⚠ Conformational heterogeneity → continuous variation (3DFlex)

docs.title: References
docs.text:
• Punjani A, et al. cryoSPARC: algorithms for rapid unsupervised cryo-EM structure determination. Nat Methods 2017.
  • Scheres SHW. RELION: implementation of a Bayesian approach to cryo-EM structure determination. J Struct Biol 2012.

docs.title: Spatial Niche / Domain Detection
docs.text: Category: Spatial Tier: 3 Status: 📝 1-pager

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Spatial transcriptomics에서 공간적 cluster (niche, tissue domain) 검출 — BayesSpace, GraphST, STAGATE 등. Sample 의 anatomical region (cortex layer, tumor margin) 자동 식별.

누가 의뢰: brain region atlas, tumor heterogeneity spatial, organoid maturation zones.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
• Visium / Stereo-seq / MERFISH AnnData
  • Cell type annotations (선택)

docs.title: Pipeline / Tools
docs.text:
• BayesSpace — spatial Bayesian clustering
  • GraphST — graph deep learning
  • STAGATE — graph attention
  • SpaGCN — graph convolution + histology

docs.title: Output
docs.text: • Domain/niche labels per spot, refined high-resolution boundaries, marker genes per niche

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• ❌ # niches hyperparameter
  • ⚠ Computational cost on large slides
  • ⚠ Histology integration variable

docs.title: References
docs.text:
• Zhao E, et al. BayesSpace. Nat Biotechnol 2021.
  • Long Y, et al. GraphST. Nat Commun 2023.
